children: InnovAge reported fiscal 2026 total revenues of $989.7 million and adjusted EBITDA of $94.6 million, marking significant improvement versus fiscal 2025. The company recorded a net loss of $0.7 million for the year and income before income taxes of $0.3 million, compared with a loss before income taxes of $34.0 million in fiscal 2025. InnovAge also provided fiscal 2027 guidance including revenue of $1,050–1,085 million and adjusted EBITDA of $105–115 million.
Total revenues: $989.7 million for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (up ~15.9% from $853.7 million in 2025).
Income (Loss) Before Income Taxes: $0.3 million for fiscal 2026 versus a loss of $34.0 million in fiscal 2025.
Net income (loss): net loss of $0.7 million for fiscal 2026 compared with a net loss of $35.3 million in fiscal 2025.
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $94.6 million for fiscal 2026, up from $34.5 million in fiscal 2025; Adjusted EBITDA margin 9.6% (versus 4.0% in 2025).
Balance sheet highlights (June 30, 2026): cash and cash equivalents $97.9 million; total assets $557.4 million; total liabilities $288.6 million.
Participant base and utilization: Census of approximately 8,230 participants as of June 30, 2026, up from 7,740 in 2025; total member months ~96,050 versus 89,130 in 2025.
Center-level contribution margin (non-GAAP): $227.8 million for fiscal 2026, a 48.3% increase versus fiscal 2025; contribution margin as a percent of revenue rose to 23.0% from 18.0%.
Operational scale: serving participants across 20 centers in six states as of June 30, 2026.

Capital allocation and investing: capital expenditures included purchases of property and equipment of $14.3 million for fiscal 2026; company reported proceeds from certain asset sales and reclassifications related to prior development activities.

Fiscal 2027 operational outlook: guidance anticipates census growth (8,625–8,850) and total member months of 101,000–102,500, supporting management's revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance for the year ahead.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
